{{Quote|Kelvan, do you know of any systems nearby with asteroid fields, something that could conceal us from their sensors?''"<br />"''No, but I think I know of something even better. Terae, can you explain to the Princess about Rethel Point? I'll send you the coordinates now.|[[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and [[Dannan Kelvan]]|<ref name="RE" />}}
This '''unidentified system''' was located in the [[Far Xandil sector/Legends|Far Xandil sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> within the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The [[Star system/Legends|star system]] bore no name and only had a numerical designation. It contained a [[Unidentified planet (Rethel Point)|planet]] that was [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] by two small [[Moon/Legends|moons]].<ref name="RE" />

The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was the location of a [[Unidentified city (Rethel Point)|ruined city]] that emanated a [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] disruption field known as [[Rethel Point]]. The field spread across most of the planet, growing slightly weaker the farther it stretched from the ruins of the [[City/Legends|city]], and ended just before reaching the orbital paths of the moons. It was rumored that a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]], the [[Rethel]], had built the city at one [[Time/Legends|time]] long before [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]]. However, the ruins were so old, with so little evidence left behind by the builders, that the idea that their name had somehow survived was hard to believe.<ref name="RE" />
